federation.managedMappings.tree.title: Choose from resource folders
federation.managedMappings.tree.tip: Only folders used by this device’s own resources are listed. Expand a folder to load its children, then choose a mapping prefix. Mapping changes access paths; it does not move files.
federation.managedMappings.tree.empty: No resource folders at this level
federation.managedMappings.tree.alreadyM: This path is already mapped. Edit its mapping below.
federation.managedMappings.tree.added: Path added. Choose the corresponding folder on this device, then save.
federation.managedMappings.draft.found: An unsaved path-mapping draft is available.
federation.managedMappings.draft.changed: The pairing or saved mappings have changed. Review the restored draft; changes are checked before saving.
federation.managedMappings.draft.saved: Draft saved in this browser. It is cleared after the mappings are saved successfully.
federation.managedMappings.draft.unavail: This browser could not save the draft. Keep this page open to retain your edits.
federation.managedMappings.conflict: Saved mappings changed while you were editing. Review the current configuration below before replacing it with your edits.
federation.managedMappings.conflictAgain: The configuration changed again. Please review it once more.
federation.managedMappings.useCurrent: Discard edits and use current configuration
federation.error.MappingTreeBusy: The folder tree is being prepared. Try again shortly.
federation.error.MappingTreeExpired: The folder tree expired. Refresh it to continue.
federation.error.ManagementUpdateRequire: Update the other device to use this feature. You can still enter path mappings manually.
